children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may retest a support at $12.52-1/2 per bushel, a break below which may trigger a fall to $12.43.
A wave c from $12.97-1/2 has briefly travelled below its 100% projection level of $12.58-1/4. It is highly likely to extend to $12.43, the 138.2% level.
Resistance is at $12.67-1/2, a break above which may lead to a gain to $12.73-1/4. On the daily chart, the contract fell below a rising channel.
A duplicated channel indicates an aggressive target of $11.88-1/4, which is also supported by the wave theory, as the bottom of a wave b is at $12.65-1/4, near $11.71.
A realistic target is $12.30, the 61.8% retracement of the uptrend from $11.65.
